doc.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000

title: Being the oldest bassist; the 'Super Bass' recording
summary: Brown jokes about being the oldest bass player since Milt Hinton retired; they discuss a three-bass tune on his recent 'Super Bass' record.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh God. The oldest bass player, now that Milt Hinton has retired I’m the oldest.

Okay you’re the oldest. But it’s documented on record that you’re still playing great, and I want to congratulate you on your long career. I wanted to ask you just a bit about this particular thing that you had done fairly recently.
Yeah. Since I wasn’t at this gig, was there three guys actually playing on this tune or was that just —
